user.title: GridWitness server
user.description: Where should this node send its measurements? Use the address of the GridWitness ingest server. During local testing you can allow an insecure (self-signed or plain-http) connection on your LAN — turn this off before sending data over the internet.

consent.title: What you'd like to share
consent.description:
We ask for the least revealing useful thing and let you choose the rest. Found on this system: {discovered}.

• Grid frequency — the same number for everyone on the GB grid; it says nothing about your home. This is the useful default.
• Voltage — a reading about your local feeder, not you. Low sensitivity.
• Current / power — honestly, this reveals a lot: when you're home, asleep, cooking, charging. Share it only if you're happy to; it lets your node self-calibrate the local grid. Never bundled — it's your explicit choice.
• Weather — outdoor conditions; helps model demand and renewable generation. Low sensitivity.

You can change or withdraw any of this at any time.

data_description.loc_tier: anon = rough region only (no address) · region = you pick your grid region · data_share = enter a postcode so we can place you more precisely (your postcode never leaves the server; only a grid-area code is ever attached to data).

postcode.title: Your postcode
postcode.description: Used once, on the server, to derive your grid supply area. It is never published and never leaves the server — only a grid supply point / substation area code is attached to your data. We cannot and do not pin your data to your street.

init.title: GridWitness settings
init.description: Manage what you share and where you are, or remove your data.

sharing.title: Sharing & location
sharing.description:
Choose what you share and how precisely you're located. Changes take effect immediately: the server stops accepting anything you turn off. Your current area is: {loc_ref}.

Grid frequency reveals nothing about your home. Current / power reveals household load, so share it only if you're happy to. Location: anon = rough region only, region = you pick your grid area, data-share = enter a postcode (kept server-side, never published).

postcode.description: Used once on the server to derive your grid area. It is never published and never leaves the server. We cannot pin your data to your street.

delete.title: Delete my data
delete.description: This removes your node from the server and marks your contributed data for removal from the research lake. This cannot be undone.
